topic: Authored classic POINTCLOUD definition/reactor graph transport

scope.admitted: Locally authored AC1027+ classic POINTCLOUD, POINTCLOUDDEFINITION and POINTCLOUDDEFREACTOR records with a unique NOD-owned DICTIONARY, preserved caller root/entry names, complete dictionary membership, and reciprocal entity/definition/reactor identities and ownership.
excluded: Imported DXF and DWG classic graphs with nonzero entity references
A canonical classic point-cloud NOD root key or producer convention
POINTCLOUDEX mixed graphs, NAVISWORKSMODELDEF, POINTCLOUDCOLORMAP, and targets below AC1027
External point-cloud asset resolution or native display/semantic support

details: The strict graph admission is authored-only and disjoint from DefinitionEx/ReactorEx; it checks a unique directly NOD-owned dictionary, complete entry carriers, one-to-one definition membership, definition reactor counts, reactor ownership, and reciprocal POINTCLOUD definition/reactor references.
The selected dictionary is reattached to the extension-object emission queue after extension graph preparation resets that queue, then emitted by the dedicated point-cloud graph writer exactly once.
Definition and reactor IDs are reserved/remapped; classic CLASS records use exact admitted object counts; entity references use the configured reference resolver.
The caller-supplied root and definition entry names are preserved. The locally authored test key is explicitly not a canonical-name assertion.

controls: Generated ASCII and Binary AC1027 graph output and fresh typed readback.
Readback checks NOD root key and dictionary entry, classic definition/reactor CLASS names and counts, definition payload fields, and reciprocal emitted entity/object handles.
AC1024 target refusal and unrepresented definition name/flags refusal both preserve the existing destination.
A wrong reactor owner is refused before replacing a destination sentinel; correcting the retained owner permits same-adapter retry and readback.
All DXF inputs and outputs are created in the temporary directory; no DWG/DXF fixture is added to the repository.

peer_schema_reference.use: Independent peer field-map evidence for classic POINTCLOUD definition/reactor references and object fields; not normative proof of graph root naming or native semantic interoperability.

independent_api_reference.use: Exposes classic pointCloudDefId()/reactorId() API accessors; it does not establish a canonical dictionary name or native file interoperability.

claim_boundary: Generated authored transport evidence only. This receipt does not qualify physical producer breadth, a canonical classic root key, imported or DWG source graphs, external assets, native consumers, complete drawing conversion, or any support claim.
